metadata.title: Quantization of positive Lagrangians
metadata.abstract: A Lagrangian submanifold in an almost Calabi-Yau manifold is called positive if the real part of the holomorphic volume form restricted to it is positive. It is called $\epsilon$-positive if the ratio of the restrictions of the imaginary and real parts of the holomorphic volume form is bounded by $\frac{1}{\epsilon}.$ An exact isotopy class of positive Lagrangian submanifolds admits a natural Riemannian metric. We prove that the Riemannian metric restricted to the subset of $\epsilon$-positive Lagrangians induces a path metric when the relative Kähler class of the ambient Calabi-Yau manifold lies on a line of rational slope. The proof relies on the construction of a sequence of quantization maps from a circle bundle over the space of positive Lagrangians to the dual of the space of holomorphic sections of powers of a prequantum line bundle. The rationality condition for the relative Kähler class allows us to reduce to the case of Bohr-Sommerfeld Lagrangians. Building on ideas of Tian and Nirenberg-Wells, Hörmander estimates are used to show that functions on a Bohr-Sommerfeld Lagrangian can be approximated by holomorphic sections of a sufficiently high power of the prequantum line bundle. Consequently, the quantization maps eventually separate fibers of the circle bundle.

analysis.workSummary: 对 almost Calabi–Yau 流形中正 Lagrangian 的精确同伦类，在相对 Kähler 类满足有理斜率且限制于 ε-positive 子集时，证明自然黎曼度量诱导真正的路径度量；通过预量子线丛截面构造量子化映射分离纤维。
techniques: 高次全纯截面与量子化
analysis.breakthrough: 为无限维自然度量的距离非退化性提供有限维量子化近似工具。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。有理性及 ε-positive 下界是摘要明确的限制，不能宣称对整个正 Lagrangian 空间无条件成立。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
analysis.priorityReason: 按结论范围、几何关联与方法可迁移性安排阅读；有理性及 ε-positive 下界是摘要明确的限制，不能宣称对整个正 Lagrangian 空间无条件成立。
